documents.text: Charles Bernard Day Charles Bernard Day (born April 12, 1957) is a United States magistrate judge and former nominee to be a United States district judge on the United States District Court for the District of Maryland. His nomination to a life-tenure, federal district court judgeship during 2010 and 2011 ran aground amid opposition from Republican senators, who objected to moving forward with a United States Senate Committee on the Judiciary hearing on his nomination after what were reported to be "insurmountable concerns" by Republicans over matters raised during Day's background investigation. Born in Dothan, Alabama, Day earned a bachelor's
